target.name: American Housing Corporation
target.founder: Bobby Fijan, Riley Meik, Harris Rothaermel, William Davis

methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Pre-Seed → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.5x) to $3M total raised proxy.

data.narrative:
American Housing Corporation is a pre-seed stage company in the Housing & Construction sector founded by Bobby Fijan, Riley Meik, Harris Rothaermel, and William Davis. The company has raised approximately $2.7M to date. Comparable public or private peers within the sector were not identified for this analysis.

The stage-progression method was the applicable valuation approach given available data. Using total capital raised ($2.7M) as a proxy for current value and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of pre-seed to next-stage advancement, this method implies a valuation of $6.75M. This multiplier reflects anticipated value creation between financing rounds absent product-market fit or revenue validation data.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $6M to $8M, with a median point of $7M. Given the single-method analysis and absence of comparable company data, this valuation carries material uncertainty around the appropriate step-up multiplier and the company's actual progress toward seed-stage milestones. The range reflects ±15% sensitivity around the base $7M estimate. Key uncertainties include product development stage, customer traction, and capital efficiency relative to sector benchmarks—data points not provided in this analysis.
